description: This PHP source file defines the 'ResetInstallationCommand' class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides a command-line utility to reset an installed instance of OrangeHRM by dropping the main and test databases, removing configuration files, and deleting security keys.

classes.name: ResetInstallationCommand
classes.description: A console command class to reset the OrangeHRM installation by dropping databases and removing configuration and key files.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the command description to 'Reset OrangeHRM installed instance'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the reset operation: checks installation, drops databases, deletes configuration and key files, and outputs status messages.
